statement: The Parallel meta report found no public implementation that uses morluto/rea against Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Messenger, the Graph API, or Marketplace.
REA's documented page inspection attaches to a Chrome-family browser over the Chrome DevTools Protocol, not to Firefox or Camoufox.
rea inspect-web-network-capture is offline: recorded URLs are never fetched, and it starts no browser and no proxy listener.
Camoufox humanize must be a float in seconds. A boolean hangs mouse.move. log-cli sets 1.5 in python/browser/visibleBrowser.py.
REA's browser-observation doc says Chromium can clear another client's navigator.platform emulation when REA's CDP session disconnects.
Listaro's live poster attaches Playwright to AdsPower Chromium with connectOverCDP. It is not the Camoufox publish path.
facebook-camofox-client NativeResponseAdapter listens to responses the page already made and does not construct or replay requests.
Of the 22 identity-leak vectors, canvas hash churn and shared WebGL pixels are still open decisions. REA cannot change the pixels.
A HAR written by Playwright is an input rea inspect-web-network-capture documents (HAR 1.2), including a note that Playwright's tracer can emit a null postData.text.
No public REA release documents a Juggler or Camoufox browser provider we could turn on instead of writing one.
